offensive.name: Sentence
offensive.description: The city does not strike you. It finds you guilty, and the striking follows.

tiers.text: The damage becomes force and gains +2 dice. One additional die if the target has broken an Edict of yours or attacked within one of your Structures.
+4 dice. The target cannot issue commands, rally allies, or use Intimidation until the end of its next turn.
+6 dice. Every creature that attacked alongside the target this round and is within 30 feet takes half this damage — the verdict names accomplices.
+8 dice. The target is declared Outlaw for 1 minute: every attack against it by any creature deals an extra 1d8 force damage, and it cannot benefit from cover inside any settlement or Structure.

supportive.name: Communal Resonance
supportive.description: You bind effects into the lattice of a society's presence.

tiers.text: When an effect targets multiple creatures, designate one focal creature. Allies within 10 feet of that creature gain the spell's benefits if they weren't originally targeted.
Allies that begin their turn within 30 feet of the focal creature gain a lesser version of the effect — half healing, partial buff, or temporary resistance.
Allies that enter the range mid-effect automatically receive the full benefit, and may transfer it onward if they move within range of another ally.

Create a Civic Aura — for 1 minute, all allies within 60 feet of the focal creature are treated as if under the original spell's full effect, even if they leave and return. If the focal creature dies, the aura transfers to the nearest ally automatically.

supportive.name: Structured Weave
supportive.description: Law gives the spell its spine — and law does not expire. (Complement effect used as Core)

tiers.text: The primary effect's duration is extended by 50%. If the effect requires Concentration, you may reroll one failed Concentration check before it ends.
The duration is instead doubled, and your Concentration on this effect cannot be broken by damage from opportunity attacks.
If the primary effect has a duration of 10 minutes or longer, it becomes semi-permanent — lasting until you dismiss it, it is countered, or disrupted by a Cognition directly opposing Civilization.
The spell becomes encoded law. If cast again in the same settlement it is automatically upcast by 1 spell level and cannot be counterspelled by creatures without the Civilization Cognition.

control.name: Edict
control.description: Law does not ask. It declares. (Save: Charisma)

tiers.text: Declare a single restriction of one sentence or less. A creature that fails the save cannot willingly violate it until the end of their next turn.
The restriction lasts 1 minute on a failed save, with a repeat Charisma save at the end of each of their turns. It may now cover one action type (attack, cast a spell, use a reaction).
Declare two restrictions simultaneously. Creatures that fail cannot violate either. On a success they are still unable to act against you directly until the end of their next turn.

The Edict becomes absolute law for 1 minute. Creatures that fail cannot violate the restriction by any means — magical or otherwise — and attempting to do so causes psychic damage equal to your Verum Modifier each time they try.

creation.name: Infrastructure
creation.description: Civilization does not conquer land — it claims it.

tiers.text: Your creations are dressed stone and fitted timber. Structures gain +2 AC and may include a gate or passage that only creatures you name may use freely.

Your Structures have resistance to all damage except force and siege damage and are immune to decay, erosion, and time-based Cognitions. Constructs are civic wardens — they may take the Help action as a bonus action.

Your creations are culturally significant — allies within 30 feet of a Structure gain +1 to spell save DCs and attack rolls while defending it. A Structure made with a 6th-level slot or higher is permanent until destroyed or dismissed.

A Civic Fortification — the Structure is recognized as sovereign territory. Creatures of Intelligence 8 or higher instinctively understand this. Hostile creatures that enter must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Verum DC or be Frightened for 1 minute, and any creature that spends a minute within it learns a piece of its lore as Legend Lore.

utility.name: Common Tongue
utility.description: The most powerful thing in the world is a precedent.

tiers.text: Speak, read, and write any language of a settled people for 1 hour. Know the laws and customs of the place you stand in. Produce a document, seal, or writ indistinguishable from an authentic one.
Be understood by every creature within 300 feet that can hear you, each in its own tongue. Learn the true history and ownership of a building, road, or border you touch.
Send your voice to every creature in a settlement you have entered. Record a statement into stone or parchment so that it cannot be altered, forged, or destroyed by nonmagical means.
Declare a law over a settlement for 24 hours — every inhabitant knows it, and those who break it are known to you. Or read the full civic record of a ruin: who lived, who ruled, and how it fell.

complementEffects.name: Iron Law
complementEffects.description: Resistance to the spell is resistance to order itself — and order does not forgive.

effect.text: When a target fails their saving throw or is hit by the primary effect, they take bonus force damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6), as the weight of civilization's authority bears down on them.

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Bonus damage increases to two dice, and the target has disadvantage on Charisma checks and saves until the end of their next turn.

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Bonus damage increases to three dice, and creatures that fail are also unable to issue commands, rally allies, or use Intimidation until the end of their next turn.

complementEffects.name: Civic Ward
complementEffects.description: The structure of civilization shields those who uphold it.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, one ally within 30 feet gains a +2 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The ally also gains advantage on the next saving throw they make before the start of your next turn.

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Choose two allies to receive this benefit, and the AC bonus increases to +3.

complementEffects.name: Order's Weight
complementEffects.description: Civilization imposes structure even on those who resist it.

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their saving throw, that target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw vs your Verum DC or be unable to take more than one action on their next turn.

upgrades.text: Level 5+: On a failed save, the target is also unable to use bonus actions on their next turn.
Level 11+: Creatures that fail cannot take reactions either until the end of their next turn.
